stories.headline: A sample library ships a patch release
stories.whatHappened: The sample library released a patch that fixes how error messages are formatted when a nested object fails to parse. No public API changed and the release notes say no migration is needed.
stories.whyItMatters: The listener uses zod, and snapshot tests that print validation errors would show the formatting change first.

stories.headline: A framework minor release is planned for later this week
stories.whatHappened: The framework team said a minor release is planned for later this week.
stories.whyItMatters: The listener runs a Next.js app and caching default changes would need migration work.
stories.dates: Announced 2026-11-15, release expected later this week
